'''Weylin-Po''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Adjudicators|Adjudicator]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] she presided over a hearing between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Thelonia Redrish]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Methias Yoran]] and [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Weylin-Po appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during a Bounty Hunter class mission on Voss.
